image_pattern_summary: Verified good images show either furnished room interiors with visible hospitality amenities (heritage décor, sitting area, canopy bed, ornate tiled floors) or exterior property shots of the accommodation building (brick cottage facade, tiled roof, garden, paved pathway). Both image types clearly communicate the accommodation nature of the listing through visual ambiance rather than text. Images are well-lit, taken at close-to-medium range, and show the property in its best presentation state.

reason: Good listing images show furnished room interiors and property exteriors where the visual appearance IS the product information — no extractable text labels or printed specifications are present.
Neither verified good image contains price boards, spec sheets, or text overlays that OCR could usefully process; value is communicated entirely through visual ambiance.
Accommodation service listings convey quality through décor, furnishings, and property condition — all visual signals that OCR cannot interpret.
